neuroportRequired.name: Require neuroport
neuroportRequired.hint: Non-medical cyberware needs an installed neuroport.

actionCounter.name: Per-turn action counter
actionCounter.hint: Automatic: counts NET actions and warns when exceeding the maximum. Reminder: only shows the maximum.

selfIceDv.name: Self-ICE barrier DVs
selfIceDv.hint: DV of every barrier by number of installed Self-ICE (1, 2, 3…), comma separated.

controlNodeDv.name: Neuroport control node DV
controlNodeDv.hint: DV of the neuroport control node.

firewallDv.name: Basic firewall DV
firewallDv.hint: Interface DV to bypass a neuroport's firewall.

firewallAutoRank.name: Rank that bypasses the firewall
firewallAutoRank.hint: Interface rank from which the basic firewall is bypassed automatically.

rangeExternal.name: External cyberdeck range (m)
rangeExternal.hint: Quickhack range with a traditional external cyberdeck.

rangeExternalHardware.name: External cyberdeck range with hardware (m)
rangeExternalHardware.hint: Range with the hardware option that extends it.

rangePortNet.name: Neuroport port range vs architectures (m)
rangePortNet.hint: Range against normal NET architectures using the neuroport cyberdeck port.

rangePortNeuroport.name: Neuroport port range vs neuroports (m)
rangePortNeuroport.hint: Range to connect to neuroports using the neuroport cyberdeck port.

cableDistance.name: Maximum cable connection distance (m)
cableDistance.hint: Beyond it the cable pulls out and the disconnection is forced.

roleAcquisition.name: Acquisition by role ability (JSON)
roleAcquisition.hint: List of rules { ability, rank, maxCategory, types, note } that tell, on purchase, whether a role can get an unavailable item. It does not block: the GM decides.

corporateMultiplier.name: Suggested corporate purchase markup
corporateMultiplier.hint: Multiplier proposed when configuring a shop as an authorized dealer. It only affects buying, not reselling.

theme2070.name: Sheet style
theme2070.hint: Style of RED sheets, dialogs and chat cards and of the module consoles, for every player. The 2070 sheet uses the yellow and green palette and fonts inspired by the Mission Kit character sheets, and follows the light or dark mode chosen in RED; the light 2070 sheet keeps the light background even with dark mode. It does not change the sheet layout. Only the GM can change it.

net.tooManyActions: {used} NET actions used out of {max} this turn.
net.noTarget: Target a token (T key) to connect.
net.selfTarget: You cannot hack your own neuroport.
net.noNeuroport: {actor} has no neuroport: quickhacks are not possible.
net.noOwnToken: Your character needs a token in the same scene as the target.
net.alreadyConnected: You are already connected to that target.
net.lockedOut: Recent unsafe disconnection: you cannot try again for {minutes} min.
net.noCable: A neuroport (interface plugs) is needed for a direct connection.
net.noDeck: You need an equipped cyberdeck to connect remotely.
net.noSight: No line of sight: a wall is in the way.
net.cableCondition: A cable connection is only possible if {actor} is unconscious, fully restrained or consents. Is that the case? The GM may veto it.
net.connectTry: {actor} tries to connect to the neuroport of {target} ({mode}).
net.firewallFail: Fails to bypass the firewall. The target does not notice.
net.targetIsNetrunner: The target is a netrunner: they always know when someone enters their neuroport.
net.cableAware: Direct connection to a conscious target: they notice the hack.
net.cableUnaware: The target is unconscious: they do not notice the connection.
net.cableSkips: The direct connection skips {count} barrier(s); black ICE is not skipped.

floor.blackice: Floor {n}: black ICE "{name}" (resolve it with RED rules; the GM marks it as passed)

net.breach: {actor} tries to breach {target}: Interface {value} vs DV {dv}
net.noQuickhacks: No quickhacks defined in the world (Items with the "quickhack" capability).

blocked.notConnected: You are not connected to that target.
blocked.rankTooLow: Your Interface rank does not allow that hack.
blocked.floorsRemaining: There are still floors to pass before the control node.
blocked.alreadyTried: You already attempted a quickhack against this target this turn.
blocked.targetAware: That hack only works if the target does not know you are connected.

net.unsafe: Unsafe disconnection of {actor} from the neuroport of {target} ({reason}). Usual RED consequences apply (black ICE met and not derezzed) and they cannot hack that target for 60 minutes.
net.expelRoll: {actor} tries to expel {intruder}: WILL + Concentration {def} vs Interface {att}
net.noGM: No GM is connected to apply the effect.

effects.notImplemented: Operation "{op}" is not implemented yet; apply it manually.
effects.directDamage: "{name}": {actor} takes {damage} direct damage to HP (ignores armor without ablating it).
effects.alreadyMortal: Already Mortally Wounded: per RED they automatically suffer a critical injury (roll it from the sheet).
effects.periodicStart: "{name}": {actor} takes damage at the end of each of their turns. {stop}
effects.ejected: "{item}" is ejected from {actor} to an adjacent square.
effects.controlMove: {source} controls the move action of {actor} on their next turn. The GM vetoes any obvious danger.
effects.controlAll: {source} controls the action and move action of {actor} on their next turn, using the stats and skills of {actor}.
effects.cyberpsychosis: {actor} is at 0 Humanity or less: cyberpsychosis. The GM decides.
effects.onExpireStart: {name}: {actor} has a pending effect that applies when it ends. If it is avoided, remove the effect from the sheet.

gear.smartNeedsLink: {name} is a smart weapon: you need interface plugs or a subdermal grip to use it.
gear.boltLocked: {name}: work the bolt before firing again.
gear.minAmmo: {name} will not fire without its minimum ammunition loaded.
gear.notEnoughAmmo: {name} does not have enough rounds for this shot.
gear.insufficient: Not enough rounds left: the shot empties the magazine. Damage: {damage}.
gear.ricochetRequested: Ricochet request sent to the GM.
gear.ricochetAsk: {user} wants a ricochet shot: {actor} with {name}. Is there a clear path from the bounce point to the target?
gear.ricochetApproved: The GM allows the ricochet of {actor} with {name}.
gear.ricochetVetoed: The GM does not allow the ricochet of {actor} with {name}.
gear.ricochetShot: Ricochet shot: range is measured from the shooter. Shotgun shells: the spread starts from a surface up to {radius} m away.
gear.chargedShot: Charged shot: ROF {rof}; pierces {cover}; target SP ×{sp}. The GM confirms the pierced cover.
gear.noAmmo: You have no ammunition compatible with this weapon.
gear.requirementFailed: {actor} uses {name} without meeting its requirement. The GM applies the consequence.
gear.requirementAlready: {actor} uses {name} without meeting its requirement, but already has {injury}.
gear.requirementInjury: {actor} uses {name} without meeting its requirement and suffers {injury}.
gear.retryOffer: {name} with enhanced smart ammunition: if you missed by {margin} or less, you may try again with {base} + 1d10 (+LUCK) and the same penalties ({penalties}).
gear.ignoreVisibility: Penalties for darkness, smoke, fog or visual obstructions are ignored (the GM applies this).
gear.retryNotAllowed: You can only retry if you missed by {margin} or less.
gear.retryResult: Second attempt: {total} against DV {dv} ({base} + {die} + LUCK {luck} + penalties {penalties}).
gear.critChooseOffer: {name} causes a critical injury: the attacker rolls {rolls} times on the table and chooses.
gear.noCritTables: The critical injury tables configured in RED could not be found.
gear.injuryNotFound: The injury {name} was not found in the RED compendium.
gear.exclusiveActive: Another cyberware incompatible with {name} is already active.
gear.exclusiveInstalled: You cannot install {name}: another cyberware of the same exclusive kind is installed.
gear.needsNeuroport: You cannot install {name}: a neuroport is required (except for medical-grade cyberware).
gear.creationQuestion: Is this installed during character creation? If so, it is free, causes no Humanity loss and does not reduce maximum Humanity.
gear.creationInstalled: {actor} installs {name} during creation: no Humanity loss and no maximum reduction.

life.drugTakenSecondary: {actor} takes {name}. When the primary effect ends they roll against the secondary effect (DV {dv}).
life.drugProlonged: {actor} takes another dose of {name}: the primary effect is prolonged.
life.secondaryRoll: Secondary effect of {name} ({actor}): {total} against DV {dv} (stat {stat} + skill {level} + 1d10 {die}).
life.secondaryFail: Not beaten: the secondary effect applies.
life.monthlyHint: At the start of the month, after paying for lifestyle: enter how many long-term environmental effects of each severity apply. Losses are applied first, then gains, without exceeding the maximum.
life.goodLife: Good life: +3d6 (proposed with 4 or more gain effects and fewer than 3 loss effects)
life.badAcquisition: The role acquisition setting is not valid JSON: it is ignored.
life.acquisitionYes: {actor} can get {name} ({category}) one at a time even if unavailable: {abilities}.
life.acquisitionNo: No role ability of {actor} allows getting {name} ({category}) if it is unavailable. The GM decides.
life.vendorHint: Multiplies the price buyers pay at this shop (authorized dealer: ×{corporate}). It does not change the item price nor what is paid on resale. 1 = no markup.
